sources.title: BDADMIN-NC au format Géodatabase
sources.publisher: Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie / DITTT / Service topographique
sources.archive_integrity: fresh response length matched Content-Length; ZIP CRC test passed; downloaded bytes are not retained in this packet
sources.data_vintage: Archive last modified 2022-05-23; geodatabase members timestamped 2022-03-02; Open Data NC genealogy states that commune boundaries in Grand Nouméa, Païta, Dumbéa, Nouméa and Mont-Dore were updated 2022-03-02. Earlier recorded updates are 2020-01-21, 2019-07-16 and 2017-11-28.
sources.source_chain: DITTT BDADMIN-NC geodatabase, layer PROVINCES, feature names PROVINCE_NORD / PROVINCE_SUD / PROVINCE_DES_ILES; source coordinates are EPSG:3163. The source read-me says the database presents New Caledonia, province and commune administrative boundaries, positioned according to regulations in force, and that coastline/natural limits are revised through BDTOPO-NC update projects.

internal_documents.relevant_terms: Reference scale 1:10,000; identifies regulation-positioned administrative limits; states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and incorporates the DITTT CGU.

Excludes commercial use; requires attribution with product year; cautions that the data have not, absent specific notice, received strict topological structuring or systematic completion and warns against use above the designed scale.

license_evidence.assertion: ArcGIS item metadata links Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open License.
DITTT's download catalogue says the listed geographic databases, including BDADMIN-NC, are free under Licence Ouverte 2.0.
DITTT's September 2019 database summary states BDADMIN-NC is under Creative Commons BY-NC-SA.
Open Data NC repeats the 2017 DITTT conditions-of-use attachment without declaring a replacement license.
The current product page links separate CGU, Creative Commons, and tariff documents; it does not identify which linked license supersedes the package's embedded terms.

sources.license_disposition: unknown; restoration-only. The ArcGIS/catalogue Open License 2.0 assertion conflicts with the source archive's embedded CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 read-me and non-commercial 2017 CGU, and the current DITTT product page exposes a separate CC BY-NC-ND link. No interpretation or redistribution permission is inferred. Ask DITTT to identify the release-specific terms and whether derived boundary data may be redistributed.
sources.restoration_instructions: Only after the user/reviewer independently establishes authorization, download the exact URL above, require HTTP last-modified 2022-05-23 and exactly 25,287,153 bytes, verify SHA-256 66363268e37d5f58c9e49864ea29ef11ecf518f4d24b09b31daa98bcc6c6e59d, verify ZIP CRCs, extract BDADMIN-NC.gdb, and open its PROVINCES layer with an OpenFileGDB reader. Do not add the archive or its extracted geometry to this repository until the license conflict is resolved.

sources.title: Limites des provinces et des communes de Nouvelle-Calédonie à différentes échelles
sources.publisher: Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie / DITTT / Service topographique
sources.dataset_vintage: Source item identifies 2024-10-28 update; service metadata says the administrative layers are served at different scales and includes a 2022-03-02 municipality update.
sources.license: Open License assertion recorded by source owner; existing parent packet preserves lossless per-feature source objects.
sources.limitations: The query requested maxAllowableOffset=0.00005 degrees, precision 6 and EPSG:4326. All three raw province polygons are invalid nested-shell geometries; this query is a generalized service response and is retained unchanged as the original, not repaired.

sources.title: Loi organique n° 99-209 du 19 mars 1999, Article 1 (version in force)
sources.license: Official public legal text; no copy retained
sources.role: Administrative tier, province names and named commune membership; states Poya is divided between Nord and Sud by decree in Council of State.
sources.limit: The law names commune membership and does not itself supply a coordinate boundary.

sources.title: Décret du 26 avril 1989 portant répartition du territoire de la commune de Poya entre les provinces Nord et Sud
sources.license: Official public legal text; no copy retained
sources.role: Legal act specifically titled as the Poya split instrument.
sources.limit: The decree's 23.7 MB scanned Journal officiel annex was not downloaded or georeferenced in this packet. Its title confirms the legal instrument but is not independent line-level boundary evidence.

sources.title: Décret n° 2025-966 du 18 septembre 2025 authentifiant les résultats du recensement de la population effectué en Nouvelle-Calédonie en 2025
sources.license: Official public legal text; no copy retained
sources.role: Independent current administrative cross-check: 33 total communes; Îles Loyauté 3, Nord 16 plus the north part of Poya, Sud 13 plus the south part of Poya.
sources.limit: Counts corroborate administrative membership labels only; they are not evidence of coordinates, geometry validity or coverage.
